./AegisCore.PluginCli/Program.cs
using System.Text.Json;

var command = args.FirstOrDefault()?.ToLowerInvariant();
if (command is null or "help" or "--help" or "-h")
{
    Console.WriteLine("aegiscore-plugin init <name> <developer-email>");
    return 0;
}

if (command == "init" && args.Length >= 3)
{
    var name = args[1];
    var email = args[2];
    Directory.CreateDirectory(name);
    var manifest = new
    {
        name,
        version = "1.0.0",
        description = $"{name} plugin for AegisCore",
        category = "Finance",
        pricingModel = "Free",
        price = 0,
        developerName = email.Split('@')[0],
        developerEmail = email,
        requiredPermissions = Array.Empty<string>()
    };
    await File.WriteAllTextAsync(Path.Combine(name, "aegiscore-plugin.json"),
        JsonSerializer.Serialize(manifest, new JsonSerializerOptions { WriteIndented = true }));
    await File.WriteAllTextAsync(Path.Combine(name, "README.md"), $"# {name}{Environment.NewLine}{Environment.NewLine}AegisCore plugin package.");
    Console.WriteLine($"Created plugin package in {Path.GetFullPath(name)}");
    return 0;
}

Console.Error.WriteLine("Invalid command. Run: aegiscore-plugin help");
return 2;

./aegiscore-backend/AegisCore.API/Program.cs
using Serilog;
using AegisCore.API.Background;
using AegisCore.API.Extensions;
using AegisCore.API.Hubs;
using AegisCore.API.Middleware;
using AegisCore.Application;
using AegisCore.Application.Maintenance;
using AegisCore.Application.ResearchLabs;
using AegisCore.Application.Security;
using AegisCore.Infrastructure;
using AegisCore.Infrastructure.Repositories;
using AegisCore.Application.Common.Interfaces;
using AegisCore.Infrastructure.AI;
using AegisCore.Infrastructure.ApiGateway;
using AegisCore.Infrastructure.Backup;
using AegisCore.Infrastructure.Campus;
using AegisCore.Infrastructure.Cloud;
using AegisCore.Infrastructure.Config;
using AegisCore.Infrastructure.ConfigCenter;
using AegisCore.Infrastructure.CoreERP;
using AegisCore.Infrastructure.DegreeAudit;
using AegisCore.Infrastructure.Deployment;
using AegisCore.Infrastructure.DigitalTwin;
using AegisCore.Infrastructure.Forms;
using AegisCore.Infrastructure.I18n;
using AegisCore.Infrastructure.Identity;
using AegisCore.Infrastructure.Installation;
using AegisCore.Infrastructure.Marketplace;
using AegisCore.Infrastructure.Onboarding;
using AegisCore.Infrastructure.Platform;
using AegisCore.Infrastructure.RuleEngine;
using AegisCore.Infrastructure.Search;
using AegisCore.Infrastructure.Security;
using AegisCore.Infrastructure.Security.Abac;
using AegisCore.Infrastructure.Security.Pqc;
using AegisCore.Infrastructure.Payments.Raast;
using AegisCore.Infrastructure.Cloud.R2;
using AegisCore.Infrastructure.Workflow;
using AegisCore.Infrastructure.Workflow.StateMachine;
using Azure.Identity;
using Azure.Security.KeyVault.Secrets;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using StackExchange.Redis;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

Log.Logger = new LoggerConfiguration()
    .ReadFrom.Configuration(builder.Configuration)
    .CreateLogger();

builder.Host.UseSerilog();

builder.Services.AddInstallationState();

var isInstalled = IsInstalled(builder.Configuration);

if (!isInstalled)
{
    Log.Information("AegisCore starting in installation mode - no external dependencies required");

    builder.Services.AddCoreServices(builder.Configuration);
    builder.Services.AddSetupServices(builder.Configuration);
}

else
{
    Log.Information("AegisCore starting in production mode");

    builder.Services.AddCoreServices(builder.Configuration);
    builder.Services.AddInfrastructure(builder.Configuration);
    builder.Services.AddProductionServices(builder.Configuration);
    builder.Services.AddAuthenticationServices(builder.Configuration);
    builder.Services.AddBackgroundWorkers(builder.Configuration);
}

var app = builder.Build();

app.Use(async (context, next) =>
{
    if (string.Equals(context.Request.Path.Value, "/health", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
    {
        context.Response.ContentType = "text/plain";
        await context.Response.WriteAsync("Healthy");
        return;
    }

    await next();
});

app.UseDefaultFiles();
app.UseStaticFiles();
app.Use(async (context, next) =>
{
    try
    {
        await next();
    }
    catch (Exception ex) when (context.Request.Path.StartsWithSegments("/swagger"))
    {
        app.Logger.LogError(ex, "Swagger generation failed for {Path}", context.Request.Path);
        throw;
    }
});
app.UseSwaggerPortal();

if (!isInstalled)
{
    app.UseSetupRequired();

    app.UseRouting();
    app.UseAuthentication();
    app.UseAuthorization();

    app.MapControllers();
    app.MapGet("/health", () => Results.Text("Healthy"));

    app.MapGet("/", async context =>
    {
        context.Response.Redirect("/setup/");
    });

    app.MapGet("/setup", async context =>
    {
        context.Response.Redirect("/setup/");
    });

    app.Run();
}
else
{
    if (app.Environment.IsProduction())
    {
        app.UseHsts();
        app.UseHttpsRedirection();
    }

    app.UseMiddleware<GlobalExceptionMiddleware>();
    app.UseSerilogRequestLogging();
    app.UseMiddleware<RequestLoggingMiddleware>();
    app.UseMiddleware<RateLimitingMiddleware>();
    app.UseMiddleware<AuthenticatedOriginPullsMiddleware>();
    app.UseMiddleware<SessionBindingMiddleware>();

    app.UseCors("CloudflarePages");
    app.UseAuthentication();
    app.UseAuthorization();
    app.UseMiddleware<LicenseLockoutMiddleware>();

    app.UseMiddleware<TurnstileMiddleware>();
    app.UseMiddleware<AbacMiddleware>();

    app.MapGet("/health", () => Results.Text("Healthy"));
    app.MapHealthChecks("/health/detail").RequireAuthorization();

    app.MapHub<StateMachineHub>("/hubs/statemachine");
    app.MapHub<NotificationHub>("/hubs/notifications");
    app.MapControllers();

    try
    {
        Log.Information("Starting AegisCore API...");
        await ApplyDatabaseMigrationsAsync(app);
        await app.RunDeploymentReadinessCheckAsync();
        Log.Information("AegisCore API started successfully.");
        app.Run();
    }
    catch (Exception ex)
    {
        Log.Fatal(ex, "Application terminated unexpectedly");
    }
    finally
    {
        Log.CloseAndFlush();
    }
}

static bool IsInstalled(IConfiguration configuration)
{
    var envValue = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("AEGISCORE_INSTALLATION_COMPLETED");
    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(envValue) && envValue.Equals("true", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        return true;

    var configValue = configuration["AEGISCORE_INSTALLATION_COMPLETED"];
    return !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(configValue) && configValue.Equals("true", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
}

static async Task ApplyDatabaseMigrationsAsync(WebApplication app)
{
    if (!app.Configuration.GetValue("Database:AutoMigrate", false))
        return;

    using var scope = app.Services.CreateScope();
    var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<AegisDbContext>();
    await db.Database.MigrateAsync();
}
./AegisCore.LedgerVerifier/Program.cs
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using AegisCore.Infrastructure.Security.Pqc;
using Org.BouncyCastle.Crypto.Generators;
using Org.BouncyCastle.Crypto.Parameters;
using Org.BouncyCastle.Crypto.Signers;
using Org.BouncyCastle.Security;

if (args is ["--generate-ml-dsa-fixture", var fixturePath])
{
    var generator = new MLDsaKeyPairGenerator();
    generator.Init(new MLDsaKeyGenerationParameters(new SecureRandom(), MLDsaParameters.ml_dsa_65));
    var pair = generator.GenerateKeyPair();
    var payload = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("AegisCore ML-DSA-65 interoperability");
    var signer = new MLDsaSigner(MLDsaParameters.ml_dsa_65, deterministic: true);
    signer.Init(true, pair.Private);
    signer.BlockUpdate(payload);
    var fixture = new InteropFixture(
        "ML-DSA-65",
        Convert.ToBase64String(payload),
        Convert.ToBase64String(signer.GenerateSignature()),
        Convert.ToBase64String(((MLDsaPublicKeyParameters)pair.Public).GetEncoded()));
    await File.WriteAllTextAsync(fixturePath, JsonSerializer.Serialize(fixture));
    return 0;
}

if (args.Length != 1 || !File.Exists(args[0]))
{
    Console.Error.WriteLine("Usage: aegiscore-ledger-verifier <ledger-archive.json> | --generate-ml-dsa-fixture <output.json>");
    return 2;
}

try
{
    await using var stream = File.OpenRead(args[0]);
    var archive = await JsonSerializer.DeserializeAsync<LedgerArchive>(stream, new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true })
        ?? throw new InvalidDataException("Archive is empty.");
    byte[] previous = new byte[32];
    foreach (var entry in archive.Entries)
    {
        var declaredPrevious = Convert.FromBase64String(entry.PreviousHash);
        var declaredHash = Convert.FromBase64String(entry.EntryHash);
        if (!CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals(previous, declaredPrevious)) throw new InvalidDataException($"Chain link failed at {entry.Id}.");
        var calculated = SHA256.HashData([.. declaredPrevious, .. Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(entry.CanonicalPayload)]);
        if (!CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals(calculated, declaredHash)) throw new InvalidDataException($"Entry hash failed at {entry.Id}.");
        if (!PqcSignatureService.VerifyDetached(entry.Algorithm, declaredHash, Convert.FromBase64String(entry.Signature), Convert.FromBase64String(entry.PublicKey)))
            throw new InvalidDataException($"Archival signature failed at {entry.Id}.");
        previous = declaredHash;
    }
    Console.WriteLine($"Verified {archive.Entries.Count} ledger entries for tenant {archive.TenantId:D}.");
    return 0;
}
catch (Exception ex) when (ex is JsonException or FormatException or IOException or CryptographicException)
{
    Console.Error.WriteLine($"Verification failed: {ex.Message}");
    return 1;
}

internal sealed record LedgerArchive(Guid TenantId, DateTime GeneratedAt, IReadOnlyList<LedgerArchiveEntry> Entries);
internal sealed record LedgerArchiveEntry(Guid Id, string CanonicalPayload, string PreviousHash, string EntryHash, string Algorithm, string Signature, string PublicKey);
internal sealed record InteropFixture(string Algorithm, string Payload, string Signature, string PublicKey);
